Hey guys, I'm still alive, don't worry.

I received Flux's email, and realized it's been almost three weeks since I was last here. YIKES! That's a mistake that's going to be fixed. As to why I've been away, there are a few reasons, including, but not limited to: my wife telling me she is pregnant (and all of the craziness that comes with the first child), buying a house, being told (after buying the house) that I may be moving soon for work, and other assorted hectic life crap. It's been a really fun month for me, in other words.

That being said, I'm still alive, and I'm still very much interested in Scribble and its fate. I have a million ideas for it, but have had no time for it, between a massive project at work, family life, and another side project for my community. Thankfully, the side project is done as far as I am concerned, so I'll have a bit more free time. This means I can come back to Voat! I'm not saying the progress will be instant, and it'll take a little bit for me to get back on my feet, but I'm still here to help this community grow, and to help anyone that needs it.

My "revival," if you will, is going to come with a few changes, though. Slightly before going dark, I was a bit discouraged with Voat. After seeing Cashmere get promoted on the front page even though Scribble was larger and the more senior project, I started asking myself, "if the administration doesn't approve of Scribble, what's the point?" I started questioning myself, and the theme. I am a front end developer, not a designer, and so I began doubting my own creation. That was my biggest mistake. I forgot that this isn't about the accolades, or the flashiest looking theme, this is about the people. This is about improving Voat as a whole; whether Scribble does it, or some other theme does it, I'm fine with that. It took a pretty big hit to my ego to get me to see that clearly. For even having that ego in the first place, I apologize. I abandoned the users, and I need to make sure that I continue what I set out to do: provide help to those that ask for it. A theme is a theme, and design tastes come and go, but the users are what makes something great. I always thought Oscar winners were playing the crowd when they thanked their fans, but now I can really see that it's true, and it's important to remind myself every day that I didn't make this theme what it is, you guys did. Sure, I made the basic idea of it, but it would be nothing like what it is today without the feedback and encouragement of every single one of you. For letting you down, I am sorry from the core of my being. I can promise all of you that I won't be going completely dark, again. I may not be on every day, but there won't be much time between my visits to the site. I'll still be here to help everyone out, and I'll still be here to look at some of the amazing work people do with their subverses.

To my brothers and sisters of Scribble and Voat as a whole: I'm back, and I'm not leaving, again.

Thank you for reaching out to me, Flux, and Clayton for your concern and post. I am deeply humbled, and I can't tell you how much I appreciate having such dedicated fans of Scribble. It means a lot to me.

Now... to start fixing some bugs, and answering some questions!
Glad to see you back. Congrats on the baby!

If you play as a horde you have the option to pillage holdings, which can eventually destroy them. On the plus side it makes more space for your glorious horde's grazing lands, gives a decent amount of gold and tech, and instantly spreads culture and religion, but it also makes the revolt risk insanely high. So if you've got a lot of really built up holdings you've just conquered, by the time you burn everything down quite a few revolts will have popped up in the mean time. Keeping the buildings and just giving them to vassals also has the benefit of giving max taxes and levies, regardless of the vassal's opinion of you. With benefits to both options, would it be better to burn everything down, or just have one space open for your grazing lands and give out the rest of the minor titles?
To pillage or not to pillage?
